source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 20 May 1964, p. 4 ("Six years, is filled")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the North Down nominations report read on the page image of the Belfast Telegraph, 20 May 1964, p. 4 (BNA article 50): 'the Ards Peninsula division of Quintin' has a representative for the first time in six years; James Joseph McMullan returned after Eric James Meadowcroft withdrew.

note: Triennial election of North Down Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Contests and unopposed returns are reported, but the only division whose result is printed with a member's name in the report read is Quintin, 'the Ards Peninsula division of Quintin', where a withdrawal left a walk-over. Returned unopposed after Mr. Eric James Meadowcroft withdrew his nomination. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Belfast Telegraph, 20 May 1964, p. 4 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the division is Quintin ('the Ards Peninsula division of Quintin'), not a division called Ards Peninsula; the name was changed, and the file was renamed to quintin.json (13 Nov 2026).
